labeled_examples.text: I will keep this short.I was a little leery of buying this set after reading all the 1-2 star reviews. The price was right though so I took a chance.It turns out that the quality is excellent. Yes, these are the theatrical versions. If you are looking for some of the extra stuff not in the theatrical release (as many Star Trek Fans may be) then don't buy this set. Spend more money. For me though, the cuts that they made for the theatrical release do not stop me from enjoying these movies as I also enjoyed them in the theater.Why only 4 stars? It's not quality related since the quality is good. The 4 stars is only recognizing that some people may be looking for the directors cut. If I was just rating this for myself I would give it 5 stars.
